label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 41
title: MVP: explicit dashboard coverage for remaining backend capability families (beyond BI-0015 generic)
body:
Backend families that have NO specific dashboard item yet (BI-0015 claims 'all 176' generically; these need named pages/components):
- Auto-mode/PERSONA: core/human_proxy.py, core/persona.py (who the proxy emulates; /api/persona).
- Squad: core/squad_manager.py (/api/squad/status, /api/squad/form).
- Learning: core/cross_project_learning.py (/api/learning), core/multi_model_review.py.
- Verification: core/verification_policy.py, core/verification_runner.py, core/app_smoke.py.
- NFR: core/nfr_runner.py, core/nfr_coverage.py; VQA core/visual_qa.py (stages 4x-vqa).
- Design: core/design_tokens.py, core/design_critic.py (/api/design-review).
- Deploy/build: core/deploy_providers.py, core/target_selector.py, core/sizing.py, core/build_utility.py, core/docker_compose_generator.py.
- Gates: core/code_quality_gate.py, core/compliance_action_handler.py, core/spec_review.py.
- Change/defect: core/change_registry.py, core/defect_loop.py (RCCA).
- Knowledge: core/knowledge_compiler.py, core/knowledge_router.py.
- Content/media: core/domain_research.py, core/marketing.py, core/presentation_generator.py, core/pdf_generator.py, core/video_generation.py.
- Forge governance: core/forge_constitution.py, core/forge_store.py (/api/forge/plan|state).
- Scheduling/locking: core/lock_manager.py, core/state_machine.py, core/queue_manager.py.
- Config generators: core/integration_advisor.py, core/techstack_guidelines.py, core/tech_stack.py, core/service_catalog.py.
- Agent introspection: core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_requirements.py, core/agent_rules.py, core/agent_spec.py, core/agent_structure.py, core/agent_migrator.py, core/reasoning_skills.py, core/tool_registry.py, core/tool_cache.py.
- Infra/safety: core/write_safety.py, core/mobile_tester.py (mobile TEST execution, distinct from the deferred mobile client).
